lines.en: She doesn’t have to lead for long as the main benefit to her living in Chika’s old place is that I know exactly where everything is.

Every light switch, every soft spot on the floor that makes me question whether or not it can support someone of my weight, every zabuton I’ve internally catalogued in order of most to least comfortable.

Of course, the main setback to Yumi living here is that any memory I’m fortunate enough to make with her will come on the wings of betrayal — even if Chika’s too far gone to think of it that way anymore.
I can still picture it clearly when I purge the more lascivious images from my kaleidoscopic mind.
I see them sitting here — gathered around the chabudai with groceries picked up after 7:00 PM when the discounts kick in.

Yumi is reading manga. Chinami is playing games on her phone. Chika’s painting her nails watching some variety show on TV. Probably one featuring my childhood friend turned girlfriend turned ex turned girlfriend again.
And I’m not there.
I’m somewhere else.
Probably home, eating something Ami made for me. Maybe I’m at the shrine with Maya. Maybe I’m sparring with Ayane again. I don’t know.
I’ve never been good at envisioning fantasies with me in them because it tends to make all of them worse. And the amount of space in my head is best reserved for happier things these days.
It’s my body that disagrees with that. And this cursed muscle in my chest called a “heart” that I never figured out how to connect to the part of me that actually makes my decisions.
Which part that is changes with the weather. And if there’s anything I know about Kumon-mi, it’s that the weather rarely changes at all.
: Here.
I have my moments. Everyone does.
But...
: Turns out I did have some tea left after all.
: It’s just gross ass houjicha, though. I hate that shit, so Chika must have forgotten to take it with her when she moved out. Tea doesn’t go bad, does it?
But the moments where my heart does dictate my actions typically feel more monumental than this.
This just feels normal even when it’s anything but. Like any other day. Like two people sitting at a chabudai drinking tea and wanting to connect but not fully understanding how.
With Chika, there was guidance. There was someone who could take these things and bend them into something beautiful.

My hands aren’t meant for that. The only reshaping I do comes in the form of symbolically decapitating Barbie dolls and then showing their headless, naked bodies to an army of my other plastic corpses.
Yumi won’t lead. And I can’t lead someone like her. She’s not as malleable. She’s stiff and she’ll break if I’m not careful enough. I can’t stomach another head in my hands.
: If you’re going to start getting weird and blacking out again or whatever, let me know now so I can go lock myself in the bathroom and wait until it’s over.
: No, I...I’m fine. Thank you for the tea. Again. I much appreciate the flavors of forgotten houjicha.
: My bad, dude. I ain’t exactly used to having company.
: None at all? So Chika doesn’t ever come back over here? What about Noriko?
: Noriko came over, like...once. Chika’s too busy now between work and being a literal fucking psychopath. So if I ever see her, it’s at her place.
: Are you guys back to normal yet? I know she was still kind of...off when stuff started happening with your mom. Otherwise you would have called her instead of me.
: It’s...complicated. Like, I want to be friends with her again and shit. I’m just not really sure what my place in her life is anymore, you know?
: Not really. Elaborate?
: Well, like...you do know she almost killed me that one time when she thought you and I were doing shit behind her back, right?
: Right. Which is now a thing she knows I’m doing with a bunch of other people who she has yet to actually murder on account of Olympic level mental gymnastics.
: Right. But she and I were actually close. So what’s she going to think when she finds out I actually like you now?
: Excuse me. Could you repeat that, please?
: L...Like as a...person! Or whatever! Not like I actually like you, like you. I never said love.
: Well, if it’s just that, I’m sure she’d be happy. She’s been trying to get you and I closer from the start, hasn’t she?
: I guess...But part of me feels like she was only doing that because she knew I wouldn’t actually bite.
: Yet here you are — inviting me inside. And all it took was sexual assault, a few apocalypses, and your mom getting cancer. And people say I don’t have game.
: Literally nobody says that. You’re so fucking popular among teenagers that somebody might think you were an idol too if they didn’t know any better.
: I can’t be an idol. It’d give my girlfriend one less thing to lord over me if we were equal on that ground.
: Yeah...that’s another thing that makes me question whether or not trying to go back to “normal” with Chika would really work right now. She’s...got a lot going on too.
: And we both know I ain’t exactly a good influence. So chances are I’d just make shit worse if I tried to be there for her or whatever.
: Right. But we also know she loves you so much that she tried to infiltrate the literal Yakuza just to get you back, so I wouldn’t really understate how much something like this could mean to her.
: I just ain’t really sure what to say, you know? Like I obviously ain’t into girls or whatever, but it feels kind of like we broke up and are just...acquaintances now.
: Which sucks extra hard for me since it means you of all people are probably the one I’m closest to all of a sudden.
: Don’t let Noriko hear you say that. She’s your new girlfriend now that Chika’s been sidelined.
: And you’re, like...actually calling Noriko’s sister your girlfriend now, huh?
: To be fair, it’s not like I have much of a choice when she plastered it all over social media. But...yeah. That’s what I’m calling her. She’s earned it.
: How?
: Well, you know how much you’ve hated putting up with me over the few years we’ve known each other? Take that and multiply it by like...I don’t know. A lot.
: Can’t tell what’s worse — having to go through Hell for so long or getting you as the consolation prize.
: Exactly. Which is why I’ve decided to just let her have this if she’s so set on wanting it.
: Well, I don’t know the girl. But if she’s anything like Noriko, it only makes sense that she’d be dumb enough to want something as un-wantable as you.
: If I’m so un-wantable, why did you kiss me in a love hotel?
: You probably drugged me. That’s the only explanation I can think of, so...
: Also, it was on your fucking cheek. Only a fucking...virgin loser would get excited over something like that.
: Yumi, I have some news that might surprise you.
: Yes, Sensei. I know you’re not actually a virgin. I have already conceded that a bunch of the fucking idiots we know were stupid enough to let you do shit to ‘em.
: You still feel like a virgin, though. And it makes me feel good when I insult you, so I’m going to keep doing it even if I know I am technically wrong.
: Which is totally fair. And also why I can say you’re in love with me even if I know I am technically wrong.
: Yumi?
: What if I, like...was, though?
: I’m sorry?

: Like...we both know you’re not a virgin. But you can’t know for sure that I don’t feel that way about you, right? So it could be, like...really insensitive to say something like that to me if I actually was.

: Well...sure. But at a certain point, that would kind of be your fault, wouldn’t it? Like you’ve had more than enough opportunities to indicate to me that you have actual feelings and don’t just hate me.
: I’ve told you plenty of times I don’t hate you. I just don’t love you either. So I’m somewhere in between.
: Right. Which is why-
: Hypothetically, though...
: Would anything even change if I did feel that way?
: You have an actual girlfriend now. Both of my friends like you. My mom probably likes you. So me liking you too would just...that would suck for everybody, right?
: Like, the only one of those girls I can compete with in anything is my fucking mom and that’s just because she’s a rapidly decaying junkie bitch.
: And I, like...you can call me a fucking loser or whatever since I’m about to sound like a virgin too, but...I don’t think I’d be as good at mental gymnastics as Chika. Or as...motivated as Noriko.
: I wouldn’t be okay with just...doing stuff or whatever. I’d want to, like...actually date somebody if I had feelings for them. Hypothetically, obviously. And you’d be a terrible choice for that.
: Yeah...I would. So it’s for the best if you don’t feel that way about me. And that you stick to your guns if you feel like it’s ever on the verge of happening.
: Yet here I am...inviting you inside.
: Yumi-
: I don’t regret it, you know.
: Don’t regret...what?
: K...Kissing you...
: Again, it was just on the cheek. And you were, like...there for me and shit. So...let’s just say you earned that the same way Noriko’s sister earned the right to date you or whatever.
: Just don’t fucking make fun of me for it or I’ll rip your balls off. Got it?
: Can I sit a little closer to you?
: W...What? Are we not close enough already? Why?
: I can’t reach you from here.
: Why...would you need to reach me? I’m okay right now. I don’t need to be, like...comforted again or anything.
: I’m not looking to comfort you. I’m just trying to be proactive here since I think we both want to be closer and you’re too stubborn to come out and say it.
: You...want to be closer to me?

: Well, I mean, like...obviously you want to be closer to me. You’ve dedicated your entire life to trying to get into my pants. But, like...doing that right after I said I’m not really...like that is...fucked up, right?
: Is me doing something fucked up really that out of the question?
: Well, no...but-
: Besides, if I ever did make some sort of actual move on you, one that I’m entirely conscious for, it would be because I think you’re special. Not because I just want to get in your pants.
: That’s something else you probably shouldn’t say...Like...in the event that I do actually like you or whatever.
: That’s it. I’m coming over there.
: D...Do whatever you want. It’s not like I...actually care or anything...
: Spoken like a true tsundere.
: Don’t call me fucking tsundere. You being into girls who are mean to you doesn’t automatically mean that anyone who is just wants to fuck you.
: Who said anything about fucking? We’ve already established that you’re looking for a traditional romantic relationship full of hugs and kisses and hand-holding, right?
: I made you tea. You’re not allowed to make fun of me.
: If I did something right now, would you be mad at me?
: Depends on...what you did, I guess.
: Look at me.
: No. You’re gross and it’ll make me puke.
: Okay. I’ll just go home then.
: No! That-
: You know, when I first sat down at the chabudai tonight, I had this whole inner monologue about how it feels wrong to be here with you instead of Chika.
: Kudos for...not just imagining me with my shirt off, I guess...
: I think I was looking at it wrong, though. This isn’t the same place it was back then even if it is the same building.
: This is your home now. It’s one more sign of you starting over and trying to make something out of yourself when the odds have been stacked up against you from the start.
: I’m so proud of you, Yumi. Even if you are still a total bitch.
: Thanks...that means a lot...even if it’s coming from a serial groomer who stops being attracted to girls once they graduate high school.
: We’re caught in a timeloop, Yumi. You’re not graduating any time soon.
: I don’t want to make things harder for Chika...And Noriko-
: Oh, right. She wanted us to film this, didn’t she?
: Film what? What are...what’s...I-
: Whh...whtrr...mmn?!
: Mmmh...
I have my moments. Everyone does.
And it matters not that the weather never changes here when I hold in my hands the key to the clouds.
A drought can only last so long — and if I’m ever to reach a world where it always rains, I will need to spur those same clouds to action every now and again.
I have learned from my mistakes. Not to the point where I will no longer make them, though. I just make better ones now. Like relying on my lips instead of my tongue.
Like not reaching into her shirt and tearing her sarashi clean off to see what she’s been hiding from me.
Like not backing down this time when I think we both felt like I would.
Something’s changed in her. And I don’t know if it’s just that I’ve worn her down by now, but I don’t care.
A collector collects. And I intend to cherish and protect this part of it the only way I know how...
By obsessing over her in the beginning, giving her the most coveted spot atop my mantle, then subtly moving her downward while she sleeps so that she doesn’t know she’s moved at all.

In this moment, though, where everything else fades into the background, there is nothing I want more than to give her the love she deserves the most. One that’s black and broken. Unrelenting, undeserved.
It isn’t true love.
But it’s something close.
: Uhhhhhhhh........
: Did you hate it?
: Did I...hate it?
: Yeah. This is a great chance to save face and tell me you didn’t want this. And that I’m just being a creepy old dude with a thing for teenagers again.
: Just think of how much you could get me to grovel if I forced myself on you a second time.
: I don’t...know what happens now...
: What do you mean?
: Like...do we...
: I don’t...think I’m ready for...anything else yet...
: Well, that’s good. Because this is all we’re doing today.
: Today?...So-
: The floodgates have opened. It took a while, but you’ve finally been successfully indoctrinated into the harem.
: Is that really something you should be saying right after taking my first real kiss?
: I’ll be taking a lot of other firsts from you soon. It’s best to get used to it now while they’re all still painless.
: O...Other firsts?! Painless?! What are you...why are you standing up? What do I do now?!
: Say goodnight, I guess. I need to get out of here before I start acting out more of my internal monologue and you wind up with one less sarashi.
: Wait, you’re leaving?! Just like that?! But you didn’t even drink any of the gross ass tea I made for you! That’s, like...rude as fuck, isn’t it?!
: A little, yeah. I’m trying not to dismantle any of your more “traditional values,” though. So this is necessary for your continued preservation, Yumi.

: So, we’re like...this is a thing now? Because it...I know I’m the one who invited you up here and shit. But it still feels like it came out of nowhere and I’m not really sure if you’re just fucking with me again!
: I’m not fucking with you, Yumi. This is a thing now.
: Okay, but what kind of thing is it?! You’re not gonna tell anybody, are you?! Because if you tell anybody, I’ll...I’ll kill you! I mean it!
: I’m actually on my way to tell Chika, Noriko, and your mom right now. Expect some phone calls in the next couple hours.
: Don’t you fucking dare, Sensei! You...you forced me again! I didn’t consent to any of this!
: Oh, really? Okay. I guess we’ll just never do it again then. Later.
: G...Good! Go find somebody your own age! And...delete my number in your phone! I’ve had it up to here with your groomy, rapey bullshit!
: Can’t hear you. Already on my way home.
: Good! Then...try not to groom or rape anybody on the way, asshole!
: Asshole...
: I can’t believe he just...did that...
: Fucking creep. He’s like...twice my age. And saying I’m a part of his fucking harem now? Like...what the fuck?
: You’re really picking now to stay quiet, Parei-
: Hello and welcome back to Untitled Children’s Show!
: I’m your host — ME. And joining me today is a very special guest — a real, live god!
: Why don’t you go ahead and introduce yourself to all of the viewers at home who aren’t exactly familiar with you yet?
how about you bite me? i was supposed to be getting some secondhand action with my favorite yakuza princess and her teacher right now. this is clearly an abuse of power and you know it.
: Exerting power over the powerless is exactly what your princess does though, isn’t it? And what you do as well! So the two of you really are a great match for one another!
: One thing we’re all dying to know, though, is what’s going to happen next! What’s your plan, Pareidolia? To return to a mind that has already purged you once? In clear violation of the Code of Joy?
: A mind that’s already purged you once?...
yumi. get me out of here. click your heels three times or something. fuck if i know how it works.
: What’s that...weird Maya talking about it? What’s the “Code of Joy?”
a bunch of godly gobbledygook, that’s what. you just focus on training that little mouth of yours for some good old-fashioned teacher dick.

: What we were looking for was π! Which means that, unfortunately, we’ll need to conclude today’s episode a little early!
: That’s okay, though! Because we’ve got plenty more FUN in store for you soon!
